ocr_text:
I GOT
DARK STAR TO
LOOK AFTER THEM
WHILE THEY WENT
ON AHEAD.

PRINCE AND HIS
PARTY WILL BE GOING
AFTER THEM.

BEFORE THAT...
WE SHOULD TAKE
CARE OF-

SO WHICH WAY
SHOULD WE GO?

THEY LEFT THEIR
COMRADE BEHIND
AND RAN AWAY?

HOW ANNOYING...
HOW MUCH LONGER
ARE YOU GOING TO
USE THESE FAKE
PUPPETS?!

ARE YOU
ABLE TO TELL THE
DIFFERENCE?

WE JUST
NEED TO FIND THE
PATH THAT HAS NO
PUPPETS.

ALL THE ONES
IN FRONT OF US
ARE FAKE.

DAMN IT...!
HE FIGURED IT OUT
IN ONE GO?!

BUT WHAT
SHOULD WE DO
ABOUT THIS? BLOOD...
ISN'T ANSWERING.

DON'T TELL
ME HE WENT OFF
TO DO HIS OWN
THING AGAIN.

DARK STAR...
WILL BE OKAY,
RIGHT?

WE'RE JUST...
TAKING A SHORT
BREAK BECAUSE MY
LEGS HURT.

AHA... I JUST
ASKED BECAUSE
IT'S SO CHAOTIC
OUT THERE,

AND I THOUGHT...
YOU WERE BEING CHASED
BY SOMEONE.

SO I'LL BE
UPSET IF WE GO
OUR SEPARATE
WAYS NOW.

I FOLLOWED
YOUR SCENT ALL THE
WAY HERE...

SO I'LL BE
UPSET IF WE GO
OUR SEPARATE
WAYS NOW.

HIDE AND
SEEK IS OVER
NOW.

COMPARED TO
BEING TRAPPED
IN HERE, LIKE
WE ARE.

N-NO!
I'M GOING TO
KEEP IT!

JUST A LITTLE
MORE... ONCE IT
GETS A LITTLE
BIGGER..

YOU'RE GOING
TO TAKE IT FROM
ME AGAIN?

I'M SICK
AND TIRED
OF THIS.

ILL KILL
YOU ALL...AND
BLOOM THE BLOOD
FLOWERS.
